brief: Plant Doctor — a one-screen working web app, not a marketing page: the user drops a photo of a sick plant; an AI agent on the Blocks network diagnoses it. The screen shows the photo as the subject with evidence markers pinned to the leaf, streams the agent's progress, then presents the diagnosis with a confidence value, the ranked differential, and a numbered treatment plan. — botanical, clinical calm, editorial, warm daylight, trustworthy — Next.js + Tailwind 4

reasons.page_type: The brief explicitly states a one-screen working web app with upload, streaming agent progress and result panels — not marketing.
reasons.faithful: UI-11 gives an app shell with a left nav rail plus a panelled work region of metric cards and data blocks, ready for confidence, differential and plan panels.
reasons.bolder: UI-13 has the densest, most asymmetric layering of unequal cards, stat strips and large media blocks while still reading as an operable tool surface.
reasons.unexpected: UI-9's split-screen puts a full-bleed photograph against a text column — a defensible layout for pinning evidence markers on the plant photo beside the streaming diagnosis.
reasons.hero: PHOTO-5 is a close macro of a real leaf, exactly the subject the user inspects in Plant Doctor.

directions.name: Bright Clinic
principles: the diagnostic photo is one oversized mass bleeding off the left edge; every instrument hangs off it
evidence markers are pinned to real coordinates on the leaf instead of listed in a legend
one unique geometry — the open radial confidence arc — floats at the seam between photo and readout as the anchor of the scan line

ranked differentials read as a dense micro comb of ticks, weight and length carrying rank without a color key

directions.name: Herbarium Ledger
principles: one hard vertical seam splits the screen and nothing blends across it — mirrored so the photographic mass owns the LEFT half
the diagnostic column keeps a deep interior margin so the seam's whitespace acts as the gutter
the largest ink mass is the photo; the largest type is the lightest weight
evidence callouts accumulate as inline texture on the picture plane
a single ring is the only curved geometry, marking certainty by form alone
the photo's internal vectors resolve inward, keeping it self-contained beside the quiet data column
